description: Paginated sample of the raw AI mention texts themselves, for qualitative review and verifying sentiment labels. Use to READ individual mentions. For the aggregate sentiment split use get_sentiment_breakdown; for weighted mention-type counts use get_mention_mix. Filterable by engine, sentiment, mention type and competitor. Dates must fall within the data retention window. limit is 1-50 (default 20). Answers questions like "show or export the actual AI mention texts" for a query.

competitorId.description: UUID of a single competitor to filter to; competitor UUIDs are listed by get_available_filters (competitors[].id). Omit to include all competitors

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

name: get_mention_samples
title: Sample AI mention texts
